subject: Aliax Summit 2027 — benefits, exclusivity & AV logistics
messages:
From: Sofia Marten <sofia@aliaxevents.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T08:12:00+01:00
Subject: Sponsorship opportunity — Aliax Summit 2027

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Attached is the sponsor proposal for Aliax Summit 2027 — the conference runs June 8-10 in Lisbon. The proposal highlights the premium ‘Summit Partner’ package we think maps to Redwood’s goals: keynote visibility, a dedicated 60-minute workshop theater, and a captive networking reception.

Two points I wanted to flag up front so we can accelerate:
- We hold a limited "priority speaking queue" for two Summit Partners (first right of refusal for keynote/demo slots).
- The keynote backdrop and stage step-and-repeat are reserved for our title partner by default; other Summit Partners are granted a smaller logo placement unless exclusivity is purchased.

I've included an initial package and a draft terms sheet for review. Can you confirm whether exclusivity category (AI infrastructure / inference) is required for Redwood, and whether you want to pursue the priority speaking queue?

Attachments: [Attachment: Aliax_Sponsor_Proposal_2026.pdf (94KB)]

Best,
Sofia
Partnerships — Aliax Events
sofia@aliaxevents.com
+44 20 7123 4556

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Marten <sofia@aliaxevents.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T10:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship opportunity — Aliax Summit 2027

Hi Sofia — thanks for the PDF. Redwood is interested in a Summit Partner package but we need to clarify a few operational items before committing. Looping in Hannah for ops, Marcus for the content/speaking ask, and Vanessa for brand.

Specific asks from our side:
1) Exclusivity: we are open to category exclusivity for inference infrastructure, but need the exact list of excluded categories and the incremental fee for exclusivity.
2) Speaking: what does "priority speaking queue" mean in practice? We need confirmation that priority guarantees a keynote/demo slot (not just first offer), plus the exact length and AV specs for the workshop theater (hours, mic types, stage layout).
3) Branding: exact size and placement for logo on the keynote backdrop vs. step-and-repeat. If Redwood provides a preferred placement spec (PNG with alpha), can you commit to placement proof before print?
4) Lead capture & data: are lead scans shared raw or via a portal? What’s the SLA for lead delivery post-event?
5) Logistics: load-in/load-out windows for booth and workshop AV run-throughs.

Can you send updated terms reflecting exclusivity tiers, and a floor plan with the keynote stage and exhibitor adjacency highlighted?

Thanks — I aim to confirm internally by next Friday.

— Laura
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
[Attachment: none]

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@aliaxevents.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Marten <sofia@aliaxevents.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:28:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship opportunity — Aliax Summit 2027

Laura — appreciate the detailed questions. Quick answers and an updated terms doc attached.

- Exclusivity: three tiers (category-exclusive, category-light, no exclusivity). Category-exclusive blocks any direct competitors in the inference/serving/runtime space; incremental fee is listed on p2 of the terms.
- Priority speaking queue: confirmed as a first-right-of-acceptance plus a guaranteed 30-minute demo slot in the Main Theater for the Summit Partner if exercised by Dec 15. The theater includes a house PA, wired lapel mic, and HDMI/DANTE audio.
- Logo placement: we can provide a pre-print PDF proof; Summit Partners receive a 1:1 logo panel on the stage wing (approx. 600px x 120px at printing scale). Non-exclusive partners get a 1:3 scaled logo on the backwall.
- Leads: Lead capture is provided via the Aliax sponsor portal (CSV export). We deliver raw CSV within 48 hours post-event and anonymized attendance aggregates weekly thereafter.
- Load-in: Main exhibitor load-in is scheduled for June 6 (08:00–18:00); AV tech rehearsal for theater is June 7 (09:00–17:00).

I've attached a redline: Aliax_Sponsor_Terms_v3.pdf and a Level 2 floorplan with the theater and adjacency highlighted. Let us know if we should hold the priority speaking slot while you resolve exclusivity internally; we can hold until Oct 15 without deposit.

Attachments: [Attachment: Aliax_Sponsor_Terms_v3.pdf (18KB)], [Attachment: Venue_Floorplan_Level2.png (210KB)]

Best,
Tom Ellis
Director, Sponsorships — Aliax Events

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T13:17:00+01:00
Subject: RE: Sponsorship opportunity — Aliax Summit 2027

Quick internal note on the speaking format:
- A guaranteed 30-minute demo in Main Theater is high value if we can secure demo hardware and the AV operator for live model runs. Ask for an explicit AV operator block (60 minutes) allocated to Redwood on the day of the demo.
- If Aliax won't confirm hardware, we should request a dedicated 45-minute workshop slot in the breakout studio with power and network SLA. That slot gives us more control over interactive demos.
- For brand: avoid being on the small backwall only. If we buy exclusivity, ensure a logo mutex clause in the terms so our stage wing panel is not reduced.

I'll draft a short addendum for the AV/operator hours and workshop fallback we can attach to the terms.

— Marcus
Head of Developer Advocacy
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Marten <sofia@aliaxevents.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@aliaxevents.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T15:45:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship opportunity — Aliax Summit 2027

Sofia/Tom — thanks for the updates and the redline. We reviewed internally and have the following decisions and next steps:

Decisions:
- We want to hold the priority speaking queue and will opt into the category-exclusive tier pending the final addendum on AV/operator hours.
- We can confirm the 30-minute Main Theater demo but request the 60-minute AV/operator block Marcus mentioned and a written fallback to the 45-minute breakout workshop if hardware access is unavailable.
- We require a pre-print placement proof for the keynote backdrop and an explicit clause preventing logo scale-down after commitment (mutex clause).

Next steps:
1) Please incorporate the AV/operator addendum and the mutex logo clause into the terms and re-send.
2) Send a DocuSign link for the revised terms and confirm exclusive hold until Oct 15.
3) Share the sponsor portal onboarding guide and expected lead-field mapping ahead of time.

If we can get the updated terms and DocuSign by Monday EOD (Oct 5), we will route for approval and prepare a deposit.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Laura
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
[Attachment: none]
